title: Generate a 3D model
description: Use an image, text or multiple views, then preview, download and use the result in your portfolio.
imageLimit: Choose a JPG, PNG or WEBP image under 20MB.
price: This generation costs {points} ANS compute points
acknowledge: I have permission to use this input, consent to sending it to tripo3d.uk, and accept this generation cost.
unavailable: Image generation will be available after service setup is complete.
cancelNote: Cancellation before provider submission refunds points. After submission, the result will still be saved and charges need review.
connectionFailed: Task updates are temporarily unavailable. They will refresh automatically.
requestFailed: Submission was not confirmed. Check the task list; clicking again checks the original request.
priceChanged: The price changed. Refresh and confirm again.
cancelRequested: Cancellation requested. A submitted generation will still save its result.
reviewNote: This task needs review. Automatic submission is paused to avoid duplicate generation.
failedNote: The task did not complete. Contact an administrator to review its result and charges.
multiviewNote: Upload at least two views of the same object, including the front.
partsNote: Part generation disables textures and PBR. Results must still be supported GLB files.
priceUnavailable: This configuration has no confirmed ANS price and cannot be submitted yet.
emptyHistory: Your completed models will appear here.
previewFailed: The model preview could not load.
previewHint: Drag to rotate and scroll to zoom. Previewing does not replace your portfolio model.
unsupportedModel: The generated model format cannot yet be used in the portfolio. The task is retained for review; no paid conversion is started automatically.
